Europe Heatwave Claims Lives, Prompts Adaptation Discussions

A severe heatwave has gripped Europe, leading to over 1,300 reported deaths and record-breaking temperatures in several countries. The extreme weather has strained resources, with reports of morgue capacity issues and increased demand for air conditioning. Discussions are emerging on how to adapt to such climate events, with some outlets highlighting cooling solutions used in India.
